plain: Figured in fair proportion to value or size

webster.text: That may be rated, or set at a certain value; as a Danish ore ratable at two marks.

example.quote: But by this system we are to pay our equal, ratable share only.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 12, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
